name: @rig-works/plugin-dashboard
description: Rig plugin: renders declarative plugin UI pages from the shared "ui" space (dashboard)

scripts.bundle: bun build --target bun --packages external --outdir dist src/index.ts && node --input-type=module -e "import{cpSync}from'node:fs';for(const f of['rig-ui.css','client.js'])cpSync('src/'+f,'dist/'+f)"
